theory.intro: A rate compares two quantities, such as price per item or distance per hour. Multiply or divide using the rate to solve worded problems.
facts: A **rate** links two amounts, e.g. $\$3$ per kg or $60$ km per hour.
To find the **total**, multiply the rate by the number of units.
To find the **rate** (per one), divide the total by the number of units.
steps: Identify the rate (the amount for one unit).
Decide: are you finding a total (multiply) or a rate / number of units (divide)?
Carry out the operation and include the units in your answer.

foundation.question_text: A soup recipe uses $2$ cups of stock for $5$ people. How many cups are needed for $20$ people?
A cyclist travels $18$ km each hour for $4$ hours. How far does the cyclist travel?
A machine labels $35$ jars each minute. How many jars does it label in $6$ minutes?
Eight identical notebooks cost $24$ dollars altogether. What is the cost per notebook?
A ferry travels $96$ km at a steady rate of $24$ km per hour. How many hours does the trip take?
A bakery packs $144$ rolls equally into trays of $12$. How many trays are filled?

development.question_text: A pancake recipe uses $3$ eggs for $8$ people. How many eggs are needed for $40$ people?
Five concert tickets cost $135$ dollars. At the same rate, how much do $12$ tickets cost?
A delivery van covers $252$ km in $6$ hours at a steady rate. How far will it cover in $9$ hours?
Four printers produce $720$ flyers in an hour at equal rates. How many flyers does each printer produce per hour?
A bottling line fills $48$ bottles every $3$ minutes. How many bottles will it fill in $15$ minutes?
A train travels $360$ km in $5$ hours. At the same rate, how many hours will it take to travel $576$ km?

mastery.question_text: A kitchen has $18$ cups of rice. A recipe uses $3$ cups for every $10$ serves. How many serves can the kitchen make?
A workshop must make $1\,260$ parts. One machine makes $45$ parts per hour. After it runs for $12$ hours, how many more hours are needed?
mastery.solution_text:
$45 \times 12=540\text{ parts made}$.
$1\,260-540=720\text{ parts remaining}$.
$720 \div 45$
$=16\text{ more hours}$

mastery.question_text: A coach travels $210$ km in $3$ hours, then continues for $5$ more hours at the same rate. What total distance does it travel?
mastery.solution_text:
$210 \div 3=70\text{ km per hour}$.
$3+5=8\text{ hours altogether}$.
$70 \times 8$
$=560\text{ km}$
